stabilize.reason: No stabilization work existed to do in this packet, and none was done. The defect is a deterministic domain-validation gap in pure arithmetic: a claim age below the statutory earliest age was priced as a settled figure because no floor was declared, so the same input produced the same wrong answer on every run. There is no intermittency, no timing or teardown window, no resource ceiling, and no build, deployment, configuration or performance parameter that changes the outcome — the refusal either fires on the value or it does not.
stabilize.justification: The `stabilize` phase covers performance, infrastructure, configuration, deployment, build, reliability and resource-usage issues. None of those dimensions is present here. The remedy that shipped is a correctness guard — declare `earlyReductionRule.earliestClaimAge` as a sourced pack figure and return RLTAX-THRESHOLD-UNAVAILABLE below it, at e28be5814 — and the coverage that followed asserts the boundary from both sides, at eeb2ac7cc. Both are recorded under `implement` and `test`, which is where they belong. The one adjacent property that could have carried a stability dimension was checked and does not: the refusal is a bounded comparison against a declared figure, adding no unbounded wait, no retry and no additional read. Recording a `stabilize` round here would assert reliability or resource work that did not happen, which is the fabrication this stub mechanism exists to avoid.
